title: GetAccept crosses 1,000+ reviews on G2: Here's what our customers say
summary: GetAccept has passed 1,000+ reviews on G2 (4.6/5 rating). See what sales, RevOps, and customer success teams actually say about using it.
body_markdown:
GetAccept, the Digital Sales Room platform,


has passed 1,000+ reviews on G2, with a current rating of 4.6 out of 5 across 1,268 reviews.


G2 marked the milestone with


[its own post](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:ugcPost:7503760108632334336/) from


[Paul Gilhooly](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pgilhooly/) , General Manager at G2.


Seeing the number go up is always great, especially when we know that behind every one of those reviews is a real seller, RevOps lead, or customer success manager telling us exactly what's working (and what’s not), in their own words.


*"Having worked closely with our product and delivery teams, I know these reviews should never be taken for granted. They reflect the quality of our platform, the dedication of our people, and the experience we create for our customers every day. More than 1,250 happy customers choosing to tell others about us is an achievement the entire GetAccept team should be proud of."*


– says Samir Smajic, GetAccept’s CEO and co-founder.


G2's own team acknowledged the momentum too.


*"Hats off to the entire GetAccept team. It's great to see how founders work closely with customers to share their experiences, spread the word and help educate the broader market. Here's to the next chapter as GetAccept evolves from digital sales rooms into a complete sales operating system."*


– Paul Gihooly, General Manager at G2.


## What GetAccept's reviewers keep coming back to


Across 1,267 reviews, five things come up more than anything else: ease of use (72 mentions), customer support (44), how intuitive the platform is (38), helpfulness (35), and time saved (29).


Here's what some of the most recent ones say, case-by-case.


## How Deal Rooms replace scattered emails and PDFs


Before GetAccept, a lot of sales teams were sending materials, offers, and updates as separate links and PDF attachments. Reviewers describe GetAccept Deal Room as the fix.


Marian John M., Account Executive at DACH & Global, said:


*"The Digital Sales Room took our sales process to the next level. We used to send all documents and information via email or individual links to PDFs. Now, we can collect everything from materials, summaries, videos, and offers in one place as a mini website and allow for interaction with our contacts.”*


Christelle A., a Customer Success Manager at a Mid-Market company, points to the same shift on the post-meeting side:


*"This tool quickly established itself as a true productivity lever on a daily basis, especially in the context of my client interactions."*


## Depth of CRM integrations


Integrations came up constantly, with reviewers describing it as the thing that made the rest of the platform actually usable day to day.


Franck T., Revenue Operations at a small company using HubSpot, said:


*"GetAccept is a game-changer and an essential foundation for structuring a sales organization. The tool is fully integrated with our HubSpot CRM, providing a single source of information to centralize sales operations.”*


David F., a Client Success Agent at an enterprise company using Lime CRM, said:


*"I find GetAccept very easy to use, which really stands out to me. I also appreciate the integration between Lime and GetAccept, since it pulls in personal client information ahead of time and saves me time."*


## How sales teams shorten the deal cycle with GetAccept


A few reviewers using GetAccept highlight where time actually gets saved, and it's less about any single feature than about not switching tools mid-deal.


Frederik R., Digital Marketing Specialist, Small Business, said:


*"GetAccept has made our sales process noticeably faster. The best part is the combination of e-signing, document tracking, and the built-in engagement data that shows exactly when and how long a recipient has viewed a proposal."*


Blake B., a Senior Strategic Account Manager, Mid-Market, described what it replaced:


*"The biggest asset for us has been having a quoting and signing system all under one roof. Previously, we would quote customers and then, once they were ready to move forward and sign, we had to re-enter that information into a separate signing software that wasn't connected to our ERP system at all."*


## How GetAccept speeds up proposal-to-signature


Most reviewers say "faster." A couple actually put a number on it.


Gustav A., CEO & Co-founder at a Small-Business company, switched off a fully manual process:


*"I really appreciate how easy GetAccept is for our team and our customers. The real-time insights on document engagements help us understand where prospects are in the buying journey and make follow-ups more relevant. I find the integration with HubSpot particularly valuable because it keeps our sales process connected and reduces manual work, saving us a lot of time and providing better visibility across the pipeline. GetAccept also improves our sales efficiency and shortens the time from proposal to signing agreements, with acceptance rates going up. After switching from manual processes, it has probably reduced our time spent by around 50%."*


Martyna M., Head of Technology in Marketing and Advertising, Mid-Market, described the same shift:


*"GetAccept is an outstanding solution for both business and sales operations. Since my company started using it, our workflow has become significantly faster and much easier. It is a true 'win-win' as it allows both our company and our customers to save time, money, and paper."*


## How AI shows up inside GetAccept's eal Rooms


Most of what reviewers praise is structure and speed.


Bas B., Business Development Manager, Mid-Market, mentioned the specifics:


*"Modular approach to building and tweaking digital rooms. Very strong AI page builder and copywriting capabilities, can work with a transcript of the call."*


On why that mattered for his actual deals:


*"It's a very nice, clean way to share documentation, meeting recordings, and other relevant resources. Especially on multi-stakeholder deals, it makes it easy for people who join the conversation to quickly get up to speed on what's being discussed and to explore our resources."*


---


To every customer who took the time to write one of these reviews: thank you! If you haven't left one yet, you can do that[here](https://www.g2.com/products/getaccept/reviews#reviews) .


About the author


[GetAccept](https://www.getaccept.com/newsroom/author/getaccept)

And with purpose-built AI that truly understands the context of your deals, creating and updating personalized content takes minutes. Native integrations with popular CRMs let reps work with their existing tools, while making sure activity is automatically synced and updated everywhere it matters. In short – we help sales teams work smart, close faster, and win more.
